Anthropometric indices
Anthropometric indices are combinations of measures and are essential for interpretation and comparison. In children the three
most used indices to assess growth status are weight-for-age, height-for-age, and weight-for-height. Weight-for-age is the most
used and, in many low-income countries, the sole anthropometric index used. These anthropometric indices can be expressed as
